written_before: any round-2 fine-tune or blind test
weights_reason: four tasks weighted equally; set by the user before round 2 (round 1 used 40/20/20/20)

architecture.note: learned pulses + pitch reference act only while the nod/dash command is on and for tail_s after it drops; otherwise reflex PID + base_law pulse law run exactly as bench.Classical(law). Hover and upset are therefore identical to the classical controller base_law (ratio 1.0 when base_law is the task opponent).

training.objective: mean ratio over nod and dash on fresh training cases
training.start: round-1 imitation spec of the same seed

hypotheses.H1: composite (25/25/25/25) <= 0.95 in >= 2 of 3 seeds AND T1 ratio <= 1.05 (T1 is 1.0 by construction when base_law = law_tuned)
hypotheses.H1_prime: non-inferiority + superiority: every task ratio <= 1.05 AND at least one of T2/T3 <= 0.90 with paired sign-test p < 0.05, in >= 2 of 3 seeds
hypotheses.H2: >= 2 of T2, T3, T4 <= 0.90 in >= 2 of 3 seeds (T4 is 1.0 by construction unless base_law = pulse_tuned, then T1 moves instead)
hypotheses.H3: ablations (clamp_fast, nodelay_all, noref, nopulse) raise the composite by >= 10 % or silence the pulses
hypotheses.H4: ANN of the same size through the same gated pipeline matches the SNN (no SNN performance claim)
hypotheses.secondary: per-case median ratio and paired win fraction are reported next to the mean ratio for every task (the nod mean is dominated by single misses)
